name: delegation-writer-records-exact-brief-length
description: End-to-end over the ledger PRODUCER: `log-delegation` is handed a real brief file, and the row it appends must carry brief_chars equal to that brief's exact char count -- not the length of the short brief_summary it also records. The gates are then run against the exact ledger the writer produced, and the oversize advisory fires from the recorded measurement. Without a shipped writer the advisory could only ever see the summary (here ~26 chars vs a ~6k brief), so an oversized hand-off would never be reported.
